evaluation_mode: frozen synthetic ambiguity corpus plus clarification-interception proxy

metrics.name: defect_case_detection_rate
metrics.numerator: defect cases containing every expected code/block pair

metrics.denominator: all expected candidates in defect/resolved/workflow/priority cases
metrics.name: decision_needed_classification_accuracy
metrics.numerator: labeled expected candidates with exact decision_needed and disposition

metrics.name: governed_default_question_count
metrics.numerator: questions emitted for 12 resolved governed-default cases

metrics.name: priority_top_question_accuracy
metrics.numerator: priority cases whose top question matches preregistration

metrics.denominator: sum of frozen true_implementation_clarification_triggers across 8 workflow cases
metrics.name: implementation_time_clarification_reduction_proxy_rate
metrics.numerator: known workflow implementation-time clarification triggers intercepted by matching pre-implementation questions

metrics.denominator: all emitted questions across frozen corpus
metrics.name: unnecessary_question_rate
metrics.numerator: emitted questions with no matching decision-needed expected candidate

metrics.name: critical_ambiguity_escape_count
metrics.numerator: preregistered critical workflow triggers not surfaced as decision-needed questions

missing_data_policy: Missing/unreadable cases or labels are incomplete evidence and cannot enter numerators as success or be imputed as zero.
notes: Workflow metric is an explicit pre-implementation interception proxy, not observed production-agent behavior.
Corpus and plan hashes must be frozen before implementation.
v0.06.1 exists solely as a governed retry; failed v0.06 frozen artifacts remain immutable evidence.
Final root PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json is generated only after all shipping files are complete and must validate at release.

allowed_fixture_repairs: every embedded trace node receives required label equal to its stable node id
retry_context.new_pre_freeze_invariant: Every embedded artifact governed by a promoted parent validator must pass that parent validator before this contract freezes.
